title: 637. Range Addition II

examples.explanation: The overlap of both rectangles is 2 by 2.
The smallest operation still limits the overlap to 2 by 2.
With no steps every cell stays maximal.

hints: Each step adds one to the rectangle from the origin to (a,b).
Only the intersection of all rectangles reaches the highest count.
Track the minimum a and minimum b; an empty list means m*n.
